newsitem.title: UK: Slow trade in European raw cotton markets.
newsitem.headline: Slow trade in European raw cotton markets.

text.p: Trade stayed very slow in most European raw cotton importing markets, although some price-testing inquiry was noted for shipments right after the summer holiday period.
Growths mentioned included Spanish and Greek 1997/98 crop supplies. But agreement on price levels was difficult.

Turkey has remained relatively active as domestic prices in this market have risen to a level at which imported descriptions seem attractive. Central Asian styles found some demand although US cottons still seem well favoured, owing to attractive credit terms.
